jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Nuro Driver
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Role

As Chief of Staff for Nuro Driver, you will play a critical role in driving strategic programs, improving execution, and helping refine the Autonomy Product that powers Nuro’s commercial partnerships and deployment roadmap.

Nuro Driver encompasses Autonomy, Controls, Embedded Software, Sensor Data & Calibration, and Systems Engineering, Technical Program Managers - the core technical functions responsible for developing, integrating, tuning, validating, and scaling the Nuro Driver. Reporting to the VP of Nuro Driver, you will operate as a trusted proxy and execution partner, working across internal engineering teams, company leadership, and key external partners to bring clarity, structure, and momentum to Nuro’s most important technical and business priorities.

This role requires strong strategic judgment, technical fluency, operational rigor, and executive-level stakeholder management. You will help translate complex product, technical, and partner needs into clear priorities, structured programs, and high-quality execution.

About the Work

You will be responsible for driving critical work across Nuro Driver and the company, including:

Strategic Program Leadership

- Lead high-priority strategic programs across Nuro Driver, including initiatives tied to autonomy product maturity, partner readiness, deployment milestones, and commercialization.

- Create structure around ambiguous technical and business problems, turning broad goals into clear workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, and decision points.

- Drive cross-organizational initiatives involving Nuro Driver, AI Platform, Vehicle Platform & Hardware, Safety, Operations, Legal, Finance, and People.

- Partner with technical leaders to identify critical paths, resolve dependencies, unblock progress, and escalate issues with the right context and urgency.

- Ensure complex initiatives move from discussion to decision to execution, with clear accountability and follow-through.

Autonomy Product & Partner Execution

- Support strategic partner initiatives by coordinating across technical, product, operations, and business stakeholders.

- Help define the right forums, processes, and artifacts to align partner expectations with Nuro Driver’s roadmap and execution plans.

- Identify gaps between partner requirements, internal technical readiness, and deployment milestones, then drive the work needed to close them.

VP of Nuro Driver Proxy & Executive Support

- Operate as a trusted proxy for the VP of Nuro Driver in key forums, helping drive decisions, clarify priorities, and ensure follow-through.

- Act as a strategic filter for the VP, ensuring leadership time and organizational energy are focused on the highest-impact initiatives.

- Prepare executive-level narratives, updates, and materials for company leadership, Board meetings, partner discussions, planning forums, and strategic reviews.

- Provide insight into organizational execution, leadership effectiveness, operating gaps, and priority tradeoffs.

- Represent the VP’s priorities with clarity and judgment while knowing when to escalate, align, or drive independently.

Nuro Driver Operating Cadence

- Improve Nuro Driver’s operating cadence across planning, decision-making, communication, and execution.

- Facilitate leadership meetings, technical reviews, milestone reviews, offsites, and cross-functional operating forums.

- Drive clear communication and reporting across all levels of the organization, including leadership updates, all-hands, planning reviews, and company-level forums.

- Proactively identify execution risks, organizational gaps, and cross-functional dependencies before they become blockers.

- Help the organization operate with sharper priorities, faster decision-making, and stronger accountability.

People & Organizational Initiatives

- Partner with the People Team and Nuro Driver leadership on recruiting, onboarding, performance, talent reviews, engagement, learning and development, and retention initiatives.

- Support organizational design and operating model work as Nuro Driver scales across autonomy, embedded software, controls, calibration, systems, validation, and commercial milestones.

- Help reinforce a high-performance technical culture centered on ownership, speed, quality, accountability, and clear decision-making.

About You

- You have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, business operations, product/program management, engineering operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, or a related field.

- You have experience working closely with engineering teams, ideally in robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, controls, calibration, systems engineering, AI, automotive, or another complex product development environment.

- You have a track record of driving complex, high-impact programs across multiple teams, senior stakeholders, and ambiguous problem spaces, proactively creating structure and turning strategy into rigorous execution in fast-moving environments.

- You can quickly understand technical and product context, identify what matters, and translate complexity into clear, actionable decisions and communication, both written and verbal.

- You are comfortable acting as a proxy for senior engineering leadership representing priorities, building trust across technical and non-technical partners (engineering, product, operations, finance, legal, people, and executive teams), driving alignment, and influencing without direct authority.

- You have experience preparing materials for executive audiences, partner discussions, Board meetings, or senior leadership forums.

Bonus Points

- Experience supporting customer-facing or partner-facing technical programs.

- Experience managing stakeholders across multiple offices, companies, and time zones.

- MBA, experience working at a top consulting firm, or similar experience.

- Fluency in using AI tools.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $193,930 and $291,150 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Team

Nuro’s Finance team is small and deeply embedded in the business. We partner directly with engineering, operations, and G&A leaders on how capital gets allocated, and we support the company’s most consequential decisions, from partnership economics to long-range planning. As Nuro expands its commercial partnerships, we are building a dedicated Corporate FP&A function. This role will be the first hire and foundational owner of that function. You will have significant autonomy, broad visibility, and direct access to senior leadership.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Corporate FP&A, you will establish and own Nuro’s company-wide financial planning and reporting infrastructure. You will lead the company-wide budget, headcount plan, monthly consolidated budget-versus-actuals, and rolling reforecast, which together guide how the executive team manages the business. You will also build the systems, data model, and governance processes that support those activities. Nuro’s planning process is spreadsheet-based today, so you are not inheriting a machine to maintain; you are building one. You will report to the Head of Finance and take your work directly to our CFO and co-CEOs.

About the Work

- Own the financial operating rhythm. You will build and run the annual budget and headcount plan end to end: timeline, data requirements, templates, executive alignment, approvals, and communication. From there you will own the monthly consolidated budget-versus-actuals and a rolling reforecast process.

- Own the headcount plan. You will own the company headcount plan of record and the incremental headcount approval process.

- Executive and board reporting. You will produce the financial reporting our executive team and board rely on, spanning working-team detail to board-level narrative. Your job is not to publish variances; it is to say what changed, why it changed, what it means, and what we should do about it.

- Accounting partnership and cash-to-GAAP fluency. You will work hand in hand with Accounting to connect FP&A to the close, the chart of accounts, and the ERP, so plan and actuals reconcile. You will build the ability to flex between accrual and cash views of key metrics, and help leadership understand which view is the right one for a given decision.

- Spend governance. You will design and run the processes that control how Nuro commits capital: incremental headcount approvals and budget adjustment proposals. You will make these processes rigorous enough to trust and fast enough to adapt to the pace of our business.

- Scenario modeling. Working closely with our Strategic Finance team, you will model the cash and accounting impacts of major partnerships, program launches, and financing events, and stress-test the plan against a range of outcomes.

- Financial systems and data. You will own FP&A systems and data. You will select and implement a planning platform and build the foundation underneath it, including hierarchies, cost drivers, and dimensionality, so that we can plan and report at speed.

- AI adoption. You will actively track and adopt AI tooling to make FP&A faster, more flexible, and more accurate. We expect this function to be a proving ground for what a modern, AI-native finance team looks like, and we will give you room to build it that way.

About You

- 7+ years of finance experience, including 3+ years in FP&A at a scaled technology company. You have personally owned a planning cycle and seen what works and doesn’t.

- You have operated at a public-company standard. You have worked inside a publicly traded technology company, or you have helped take a company through IPO readiness.

- GAAP fluency across all three financial statements. You understand cash-flow dynamics and can move confidently between cash and GAAP views of the business.

- Hands-on experience with planning systems. You’ve worked on a planning platform such as Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, or Oracle Hyperion, and understand how it integrates with an ERP. You have opinions about what to build in the tool and what to leave out of it.

- You can drive a company-wide process. You set timelines and objectives, obtain approvals, build buy-in across functions, communicate clearly, hold teams accountable, check the work, chase the follow-ups, and land the output.

- You see the big picture and the details. Variances tie, and you can tell leadership what in the P&L actually matters.

- One team. Our Finance team is lean and priorities move quickly. You will collaborate closely with the rest of Strategic Finance to get done whatever is most important, rather than defending a lane.

Bonus Points

- You’ve built or managed a high-performance FP&A team

- You’ve led the implementation of planning software

- You have been through an IPO, or been directly involved in IPO preparation

- Experience in AI, hardware, automotive, or other hard-tech businesses

- You have owned a company headcount plan end-to-end in partnership with a People or Talent organization

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $176,400 and $264,600 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Perception Data Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Team

The Perception ML Operations team sits at the center of how Nuro's vehicles learn to see. We are responsible for the training and evaluation data that powers perception models across every sensor modality: vision, lidar, radar, and beyond. We work alongside ML engineers, product owners, data engineers, and external labeling partners to turn ambiguous, fast-moving requirements into data deliverables the Perception team can build on with confidence.

This is a team that operates at the intersection of ML urgency and operational discipline. Here is what the work actually looks like day-to-day:

- Sitting in a roadmap review, hearing a new feature requirement land, and walking out with a concrete data collection and labeling plan already scoped against timeline and budget.

- Reviewing vendor throughput against milestone dates and catching a capacity gap before it would become a release risk.

- Querying pipeline data directly to understand where quality is slipping, rather than waiting for a ticket or ML engineer to surface the problem.

- Being the person Perception Engineering calls when they need to know whether a data deliverable is real, on time, and within budget, and making sure the team you manage translates that bar into terms vendors can execute against without ambiguity.

If that sounds like the kind of ownership that energizes you, we would love to talk.

About the Role

This is a role built for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just track them. You will translate company-wide perception feature requirements into concrete data deliverables, manage vendor allocation and budget against Nuro's milestone and release timelines, and keep a clear, defensible view of outcomes, risk, and data quality across the pipelines you own — distinguishing a one-off labeling error from a systemic labeling process problem, and closing the gap either way.

The work connects directly to Nuro's mission. Perception models are only as good as the data behind them, and every gap in coverage, every misallocated vendor hour, and every quality blind spot eventually shows up in how the vehicle sees the world. You are the person who catches that upstream, before it becomes an engineering fire drill or a safety question.

You'll partner closely with ML engineering leadership, product owners, and vendor operations, with the access and visibility to make real calls on scope, budget, and quality tradeoffs. What we ask in return is rigor, clear communication, and genuine ownership of the outcome.

About the Work

Translate Requirements into Deliverables

- Synthesize company-wide perception feature needs into detailed, actionable data deliverables covering vision, LiDAR, and additional sensor modalities.

- Own the end-to-end labeling process, from data availability through an outcome Perception can train on, directing data annotation partners to execute against that bar.

Own Vendor Allocation and Budget

- Manage vendor allocation and budgeting in direct alignment with Nuro's milestone and release timelines.

- Oversee large-scale vendor and managed service provider relationships against quality, latency, and volume targets, and hold them accountable when performance drifts.

Track Outcomes, Risk, and Quality

- Define and maintain clear, current tracking of outcomes, risk, and data quality so that status is never a surprise to engineering or leadership.

- Own quality as an outcome, not just a status: define what "good" looks like for deliverables within your pipelines, and hold vendors to that bar before problems surface downstream.

- In response to quality dips, identify whether the issue is an isolated labeling error or a broader process failure, and address the root cause rather than just the single error.

- Translate high-level product roadmaps and engineering requirements into granular operational execution plans, with resource allocation and throughput modeled explicitly.

- Query databases directly using SQL (Python a plus) to analyze throughput and quality metrics and generate reporting without waiting on engineering support.

About You

We are not looking for someone who has done everything. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, owns outcomes rather than status updates, and has genuine command of both the operational and technical sides of perception data.

What You Bring

- 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Operations Strategy, managing complex, cross-functional programs within technology, autonomous driving, or AI/ML.

- Demonstrated ability to translate high-level product roadmaps and engineering requirements into granular operational execution plans, including managing resource allocation and throughput for large-scale workflows.

- Experience overseeing large-scale vendor operations or managed service providers, specifically against quality, latency, and volume targets.

- Proficiency with SQL to query databases, analyze throughput metrics, and generate reports independently.

- A track record of holding vendors accountable to a quality bar you've defined yourself, not just monitoring metrics someone else set.

Bonus Points

- Background in autonomous vehicles, robotics, computer vision, or ML model training.

- Prior experience in ML engineering, data engineering, or technical consulting.

- Demonstrated track record of improving data quality or throughput at scale, with metrics to show for it.

- Familiarity with autonomous vehicle sensor modalities (LiDAR, Radar, Camera, Thermal) and their respective data annotation requirements.

- Bachelor's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $132,000 and $198,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. Software Operations is the processing muscle behind Nuro Driver. Within Software Operations, Validation Operations holds the bar for safety and system testing, making sure our autonomous driving software is safe before it ever hits the road. It's careful, consequential work, and we take it seriously.

Own the systems that make validation operations accurate, scalable, and ready for Nuro’s next stage of growth.

As a Senior Program Manager on the Software Operations team, you’ll partner with Autonomy, Systems, and Data Platform Engineering to deliver the high-quality data that powers critical validation and expansion efforts. You’ll serve as the bridge between Engineering, Operations, and our offshore partner, upholding the quality bar, building scalable workflows, and driving performance across the ecosystem.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants to make a measurable impact. You’ll investigate failures at their root, turn data into decisions, and lead the changes that keep quality, delivery, and operational confidence high.

You'll lead the day-to-day operations that keep validation data flowing, accurate, and on schedule, bringing structure to ambiguity and turning quality gaps into lasting improvements.

- Set the quality standard : Define metrics, sampling approaches, workflows, and operating mechanisms that enable consistent, scalable data quality.

- Diagnose and fix what’s broken: Audit live workflows, query databases, and trace accuracy or pipeline failures to their root cause, then drive measurable corrective action.

- Lead global operations : Own the offshore vendor relationship, including budget, capacity, performance, and quality outcomes.

- Drive improvement: Lead adoption of improved operational practices through clear documentation, stakeholder engagement, pilot programs, and change management.

- Build the team: Lead a small in-house team, strengthen oversight, and create processes that evolve with Nuro’s needs.

- Align teams around action : Translate complex operational and technical issues into clear recommendations for Engineering, Operations, and leadership.

You won’t just manage validation operations. You’ll make the whole function better, more scalable, and more trusted.

What you'll bring

- 5+ years of program management experience embedded with software validation and/or AI/ML operations

- Quality-obsessed approach to program management: energized by finding what is broken, not just by shipping on time.

- Deep familiarity with data pipelines and labeling ecosystems, including annotation workflows, quality sampling, taxonomy design, and inter-annotator agreement

- A track record of identifying and closing data quality gaps, with measurable impact on accuracy or model performance

- Experience managing large-scale offshore or globally distributed annotation teams

- Proficiency querying data with SQL and BigQuery, and using KPIs to drive prioritization, capacity management, and continuous improvement

- Ability to work both strategically and hands-on, from designing a quality framework to personally tracing a labeling fault through a database

- High agency and a history of building processes where none exist

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence and make complex information accessible to technical and non-technical audiences

- Experience supporting benefits administration, employee inquiries, open enrollment, vendor coordination, invoice reconciliation, or audits.

- High attention to detail, strong judgment, and discretion when working with confidential employee and company data.

jobs.title: Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Role

Nuro is looking for a senior partnerships and relationship management professional to own many of the key relationships that our technology depends on. Building the Nuro Driver requires a number of deep partnerships across cloud and compute providers, silicon, Tier 1 suppliers, and OEMs. Building the Nuro Driver requires a number of deep partnerships across cloud and compute providers, silicon, Tier 1 suppliers, and OEMs. This role builds and manages those relationships.

This is not traditional business development. We are not chasing a high volume of new logos, and we say no to more deals than we say yes to. The work involves holding a small set of critical relationships at the senior and executive level over years, keeping commercial agreements current, and making sure the internal follow through actually happens. You will work closely with our Founders and Executive Team, our existing partnership team focused on new commercial opportunities, and with our Supply Chain Team, which owns parts and schedules.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role. Success looks like partners who know exactly who to call at Nuro, agreements that get renewed on good terms before they become urgent, and problems that get resolved before they reach the co-CEOs.

About the Work

- Own senior and executive level relationships with Nuro's existing cloud, compute, Tier 1, and OEM partners

- Serve as the first escalation point when a partner relationship goes sideways, and resolve it

- Lead commercial terms, renewals, and amendments on existing agreements, working with business development, legal, engineering and finance

- Run the internal follow through: track what was committed on both sides, drive the cross functional work, and keep partners current on what is happening and when

- Hold a clear view of where each relationship stands, what it is worth to Nuro, and where it should go over the next two to three years

- Prepare clear, executive ready materials that communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and deal rationale, for internal review and for partners

- Partner with business development on new opportunities that come out of existing relationships

About You

- Approximately 7+ years of experience, starting in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy, with meaningful time since then in an operating role

- You have held a senior partner or customer relationship across multiple years, not a single transaction. You can name the counterpart and say what changed because you were the person holding it.

- Deal credibility. You have been in the room for commercial negotiations and can carry that conversation yourself.

- Organized enough that it is a differentiator. You know what was promised, by whom, and when it is due, across a lot of moving parts, across multiple partners.

- Ability to learn technical concepts quickly and explain them clearly to a commercial audience, and the reverse

- Excellent written and verbal communication with senior audiences, internal and external

- Comfortable with ambiguity and willing to take ownership to move work forward with speed and quality

Bonus Points

- Experience in autonomous systems, automotive, semiconductors, or cloud infrastructure

- Experience owning partner relationships at a company that licenses technology rather than selling a finished product

- MBA from a top university, or a degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field

About the Team

L4 driverless deployment creates an incredibly high bar for behavior quality and safety. This motivates:

- A layer of principled robotics-based safety protections for the autonomy system

- A process for solving every issue observed onroad, in a way that is fast and trustworthy

This team owns both these critical safety components and the iteration loop. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about robotics and safety, excited about the challenge of supporting a real commercial deployment, and enthusiastic about integrating solutions seamlessly with the data-driven autonomy system.

About the Work

You will:

- Own the core logic and software implementation for the robotics-based safety protections in the autonomy stack

- Be the primary POC for solving real world autonomy issues, including root cause analysis, design and implementation of principled solutions, and testing and deployment.

- Lead and grow a technical team dedicated to this problem area.

- Work cross-functionally with AI modeling teams, eval, systems, and operations.

About You

We are targeting candidates with deep technical knowledge in motion and behavior systems, strong technical judgment on how to solve robotics problems, and the hands-on leadership skills to grow a team that operates at that standard.

- Education: BS/MS/PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, EE/ME/AE, or a related quantitative field.

- Experience: 5+ years of industry experience building safety-critical motion planning, decision making, trajectory optimization, or controls systems for real-world robots or autonomous vehicles.

- Deployment Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking robotics behavior from development into real-world operation, including diagnosing and fixing issues found in the field.

- Technical Depth: Strong C++; solid math (geometry, optimization, probability) and physics (kinematics, dynamics); fluency in optimization-based, sampling-based, and search-based planning, and in combining data-driven with model-based methods.

- Leadership: Experience leading technical projects and mentoring or managing engineers; able to set direction and earn the trust of a strong team while remaining hands-on.

- Judgment & Urgency: A bias toward minimal, principled solutions and a strong sense of urgency for high-quality execution.
